literal: Theft which is called dark-knowledge boldness, measure which is called power with those who practice is not.
translation: The foolish boldness of dark ignorance known as theft is not found in those who practice the strong discipline of knowing their proper limits.
modern: அளவு என்னும் வரம்பினை அறிந்து வாழும் ஆற்றல் உடையவர்களிடத்தில், களவு என்று சொல்லப்படும் மயங்கிய அறிவினால் வரும் துணிவு இருக்காது.
explanation: The couplet contrasts two qualities: the disciplined strength of knowing one's proper limits ('measure') and the foolish boldness of stealing ('dark ignorance'). The word 'அளவு' (measure) refers to the boundary of what rightfully belongs to oneself, while 'காரறிவு' (dark knowledge) describes a mind clouded by greed. The author explains that those who possess the true power of self-restraint will never harbor the ignorant audacity to commit theft.
